examples.text: Common errors claims 'Unable to infer model provider for gpt-5.4-mini'; LangChain infers openai from gpt- names, so this error is likely invented.
Common errors says to check SMTP_SERVER, but the Step 1 code reads SMTP_HOST (lesson 11 also uses SMTP_HOST).
Common error 'KeyError: choices' cannot occur with the openai client used here; the SDK raises BadRequestError for context overflow.
The satay_server.py box ends with uvicorn and curl shell lines; Copy now yields a .py file with a syntax error. Split into a bash box.
Expected output lists tab_ledger.py, but the task saves {module_name}.py and kickoff passes module_name 'tabs', so the file is tabs.py.
The tests.jsonl box, now labelled as a file, starts with a # comment line that makes json.loads fail if copied.
Local check output (quality-out/links.json and links.md) was committed; the json is not in .vercelignore so it would be served live. Delete both and ignore qual
